premarket.market_expectations: Markets face downward pressure today with US futures and Asian indices signaling weakness, while a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields weigh on risk appetite. Domestic institutional selling offsets foreign inflows, though crude oil's retreat and a softer rupee provide some relief. Expect choppy trading with a short bias as global cues override local momentum.
